q-170852.name: Question 1
q-170852.problem:
$2$ is prime, **or** $14$ is a multiple of $7$ **and** $5.$

Express the compound statement above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $R:2\text{ is prime}$

- $S:14\text{ is a multiple of }7$

- $T:14\text{ is a multiple of }5$
q-170852.worked_solution:
The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$∧$", while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "$∨$".

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:

- **Part 1:** $2$ is prime. This corresponds to $R.$

- **Part 2:** $14$ is a multiple of $7$ and $5.$ This corresponds to

$$
{{14\text{ is a multiple of }7}_{⏟}}_{S}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{14\text{ is a multiple of }5}_{⏟}}_{T},
$$

that is, $S∧T.$

So, we can express the sentence as

$$
{{2\text{ is prime}}_{⏟}}_{R}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{14\text{ is a multiple of }7\text{ and }5}_{⏟}}_{S\,∧\,T},
$$

that is, $R∨(S∧T).$

$$
{{3|12}_{⏟}}_{Q}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{3|18}_{⏟}}_{R},
